name: com.worshipmetrics/site
title: WorshipMetrics
description: Public product-information MCP server for WorshipMetrics, the all-in-one platform for church worship and production teams: service planning, presentation, volunteer scheduling, attendance, live streaming, digital signage, and A/V monitoring. Tools: product overview, knowledge-base search, and article retrieval as markdown. No authentication; church data lives behind sign-in in the web app.
